purpose: visual-style test: 3 styles x 6 scenes x 3 seeds, blind owner pack, objective flags only

scene_specs.caption: The vent grazer crops bacterial mats at the chimney rim.

spec.subject: vent grazer grazing bacterial mats on a vent chimney
spec.environment: hydrothermal vent chimney field, bacterial mats on basalt
spec.light: bioluminescent vent glow, deep teal water, faint lime bioluminescence

scene_specs.caption: Filter drifters sieve microbes from the open water column.

spec.subject: filter drifter sieving suspended microbes
spec.environment: open water column of the frozen alien ocean, drifting particles and faint light shafts

scene_specs.caption: Chimney fields vent mineral-rich water onto the sea floor.

spec.subject: vent chimney field with black smokers
spec.environment: field of hydrothermal vent chimneys on the ocean floor, black smoker plumes and mineral crusts
spec.light: vent glow illuminating black smoker plumes

scene_specs.caption: Melt pools glow beneath the frozen ice shell.

spec.subject: under-ice cavern ceiling with melt pools
spec.environment: cavern beneath the frozen ice shell, melt pools and ice columns
spec.light: faint light filtering through ice, bioluminescent patches
spec.camera: looking up at the ice ceiling

scene_specs.caption: Chemosynthetic bacteria feed the whole vent food web.

spec.subject: food-web plate: chemosynthetic bacteria, vent grazer, filter drifter
spec.environment: vent field with bacterial mat base of the food web
spec.camera: wide plate with copy space for labels

scene_specs.caption: Plumes break through the ice crust of the frozen ocean world.

spec.subject: frozen planet surface with vent plumes breaking through ice
spec.environment: ice crust surface of the frozen ocean world, plume fractures and drifting frost
spec.light: dim surface light, plume glow from below

S-A.name: flat vector illustration
S-A.prompt: flat vector illustration with saturated colour, bold contours, smooth gradients, a rich coloured background, readable shapes and no texture noise

S-B.name: natural-history gouache field-guide plate
S-B.prompt: natural-history gouache field-guide plate with warm paper texture, visible brush strokes, detailed anatomy and a muted but varied palette

S-C.name: layered paper-cut diorama
S-C.prompt: layered paper-cut diorama with separate foreground, midground and background layers, soft drop shadows and clear depth
S-C.creature_detail_phrase: separate foreground, midground and background layers

notes: Scenes s01/s03/s05/s06/s10/s12 are the S7/S8 scenes, so the style test is comparable with the model bake-off; the palette and some background wording are re-authored per scene for S10.

The 2 habitat scenes and the wide scene carry a zero anatomy count (0 limbs / 0 eyes / 0 horns) because the read-only builder always renders the counts line; that is identical across the three styles, so the comparison is unaffected.
